THE DIFFERENCE

Three ways to get a website. Only one you actually keep.

What matters isn't launch day — it's every day after it. Here's what changes when you need to make an update.

DIY BUILDER

You're on your own

Wix or Squarespace is cheap to start, but every change means fighting a generic drag-and-drop editor — and the site still looks like a thousand others.

TRADITIONAL AGENCY

Every change is a ticket

They build something custom, but changing a price or a photo later means an email, a wait, and often another invoice. The site is theirs to touch, not yours.

MAINTAIN STYLE

Built for you, run by you

A custom site, built around your brand — then we hand you the keys. AI-guided edits mean you make the change yourself, in minutes, for free.

WHY AI-MAINTAINED

Built for speed. Held to a human standard.

Speed

Update it yourself

Make a change in minutes with AI walking you through it — no waiting on an agency's ticket queue.

Security

Scoped to your site only

Access is scoped to your site, with a full audit trail on every change you make. Nothing shared across clients.

Support

Set up, then backed up

We configure everything and stay available to help — you're never figuring it out alone.
